info.title: Aviapages API Documentation
info.description:
Wide range of tools and databases for business aviation industry.Flight Time & Route Calculator Charter Directories (charter companies, charter aircraft, business aviation airports, FBO's, MRO's)Charter Quotation (quote, receive offers, book aircraft)Aircraft Flight ScheduleAvailabilities (empty legs)Aviation Weather (METAR, TAF)NOTAM

[OpenAPI schema (JSON)](/docs/openapi.json)

tags.name: aircraft
tags.description: Executive aviation aircraft for charter or for sale.

tags.name: aircraft_classes
tags.description: Executive aviation aircraft classification.

tags.name: aircraft_profiles
tags.description: Aircraft profile information used for flight time and route calculation. An aircraft type can have multiple profiles.

tags.name: aircraft_types
tags.description: Aircraft types and variations.

tags.name: airports
tags.description: Airports used for executive aviation.

tags.name: charter_prices
tags.description: Price estimation for a charter flight.

tags.name: charter_quote_replies
tags.description: Seller (operator) offers for own charter quotes.

tags.name: charter_quote_requests
tags.description: Quote a charter flight from multiple charter operators (sellers). Making a Charter Search is highly recommended before making a quote.

tags.name: charter_search_aircraft
tags.description: Find most suitable charter aircraft with their operators (sellers) for a flight with multiple parameters and filters. Very helpful before sending flight requests.

tags.name: charter_searches
tags.description: Find most suitable charter aircraft with their operators (sellers) for a flight with multiple parameters and filters. Very helpful before making a charter quote.

tags.name: cities
tags.description: Worldwide populated cities.

tags.name: companies
tags.description: Executive aviation companies (operators, brokers, FBO, MRO, handling, aircraft dealers, ...).

tags.name: countries
tags.description: Worldwide countries.

tags.name: empty_legs
tags.description: Actual empty legs and charter aircraft availabilities of all companies.

tags.name: fbos
tags.description: FBO facilities.

tags.name: flight_calculator
tags.description: Flight time, route and fuel usage calculator.

tags.name: flights
tags.description: Information about own company's flights. Used for increasing accuracy in quoting, scheduling and historical analysis.

tags.name: metars
tags.description: Meteorological Aerodrome Reports, decoded an original.

tags.name: mros
tags.description: MRO facilities.

tags.name: notams
tags.description: Notices to Airmen, decoded and original.

tags.name: operator_quote_messages
tags.description: Quotes made by brokers (buyers) to own company.

tags.name: operator_quote_replies
tags.description: Offer generation for quotes made by brokers (buyers) to own company.

tags.name: price_calculator
tags.description: Price estimation for a charter flight.

tags.name: tafs
tags.description: Terminal Aerodrome Forecasts, decoded and original.

tags.name: tokens
tags.description: Aviapages token management.

get.description:
**Filtering.** Active, unexpired empty legs. Filters combine with AND; all parameters are optional. Use `created_at_gt` or `updated_at_gt` for records after an ISO 8601 timestamp. Use `updated_at_lt` for records strictly before a timestamp; combine it with `updated_at_gt` for a range excluding both boundaries. Sort with `ordering=created_at` or `ordering=updated_at`. Both timestamps are returned in UTC.

**Prices.** Converted prices are indicative and calculated at read time.

departure_airport.description:
Departure airport ICAO code / IATA code / Local identifier or coordinates.
e.g. "LSGG", "RIX", "39.7841944444 -104.537638889"

arrival_airport.description:
Arrival airport ICAO code / IATA code / Local identifier or coordinates.
e.g. "KJFK", "BCA", "8.45991666667 48.5683611111

aircraft.description:
Aircraft profile name / ICAO code / type. Profile name is preferable.
e.g. "HondaJet (IASA regulations)", "CL60", "Global 6000"

aircraft_tail_number.description:
Aircraft tail number. Helps find exact aircraft profile.
Overrides 'aircraft' parameter if found in Aviapages database.

departure_datetime.description:
Local time of departure in format "YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm". Default: current UTC datetime.
e.g. "2020-10-28T12:00"

aircraft_custom_payload.description: Custom payload parameter, kg. Overrides pax parameter.

arrival_datetime.description:
Display local arrival date & time depending on time calculation methods selected from above
("airway_time", "airway_time_weather_impacted", "great_circle_time", "average_speed_time" will return
"arrival_local_airway", "arrival_local_airway_weather_impacted", "arrival_local_great_circle",
"arrival_local_average_speed" respectively)

great_circle_route.description: Calculate great circle route (shortest distance) as an array of coordinates between airports

great_circle_carbon_emissions.description: Calculate carbon dioxide emissions via great circle using aircraft performance model, kg

airway_carbon_emissions.description: Calculate carbon dioxide emissions via airways using aircraft performance model, kg

airway_carbon_emissions_weather_impacted.description:
Calculate carbon dioxide emissions via airways using aircraft performance model
with historical average wind, kg

great_circle_distance.description: Calculate distance between airports via great circle (shortest distance).

great_circle_time.description: Calculate flight time via great circle (shortest distance) using aircraft performance model.

great_circle_fuel.description: Calculate trip and block fuel via great circle using aircraft performance model.

average_speed_time.description:
Calculate flight time via great circle using aircraft's average speed constant.
Simplest and fastest calculations.

airway_route.description: Calculate airway route of coordinates between airports via airways.

airway_time.description: Calculate flight time via airways using aircraft performance model.

airway_distance.description: Calculate distance between airports via airways.

airway_time_weather_impacted.description:
Calculate flight time via airways using aircraft performance model with historical
average wind impact. This is the recommended method for most accurate result.

airway_fuel_weather_impacted.description:
Calculate trip and block fuel via great circle using aircraft performance model with
         historical average wind.

airway_fuel.description: Calculate trip and block fuel via airways using aircraft performance model.

advise_techstops.description: Advise optimal airports for tech stop in case direct flight is not possible.

ifr_route.description: Calculate route as a sequence of airways and airway points used for en-route navigation.

airway_fuel_weather_impacted_detailed.description:
Calculate and display detailed breakdown of fuel consumption via airways using
         aircraft performance model with historical average wind.

airway_fuel_detailed.description:
Calculate and display detailed breakdown of fuel consumption via airways using
         aircraft performance model.

great_circle_fuel_detailed.description:
Calculate and display detailed breakdown of fuel consumption via great circle using
         aircraft performance model.

airway_average_wind_historical.description:
Use historical average wind for airway calculations. This is the recommended method for most
            accurate result.

avoid_countries.description:
List of countries to avoid in airway calculations. e.g.
["Iran", "Syria"], ["UKR", "BLR"] or ["BY", "UA"]

avoid_firs.description: List of FIR to avoid in airway calculations. e.g. ["UKDV", "UKBV"]

etops.description: Use ETOPS in airway calculations. Possible values: "ETOPS90", "ETOPS120", "ETOPS180".

tag.description: Set custom user tag. Helpful for debugging or logging.

aircraft_degradation.description: Aircraft's aerodynamic and flight characteristics degradation factor, percent.

aircraft_oew.description: Custom aircraft's operating empty weight, kg.

aircraft_mtow.description: Custom aircraft's maximum takeoff weight, kg.

aircraft_zfw.description: Custom aircraft's zero fuel weight, kg.

aircraft_max_fuel.description: Custom aircraft's max fuel weight, kg.

aircraft_taxi_fuel.description: Custom aircraft's taxi fuel weight, kg.

aircraft_alternate_fuel.description: Custom aircraft's alternate fuel weight, kg.

aircraft_holding_fuel.description: Custom aircraft's holding fuel weight, kg.

aircraft_contingency_fuel.description: Custom aircraft's contingency fuel weight, kg.

aircraft_extra_fuel.description: Custom aircraft's extra fuel weight, kg.

aircraft_optimal_flight_level.description: Custom aircraft's optimal flight level, m.

aircraft_mlw.description: Custom aircraft's maximum landing weight, kg.

aircraft_mzfw.description: Custom aircraft's maximum zero fuel weight, kg.

crossed_firs.description: Show FIRs crossed during the route

crossed_countries.description: Show countries crossed during the route

fallback_eco_regime.description: Automatic "efficiency mode": if the initial calculation fails due to weight or fuel constraints, the system recalculates the flight using the most fuel-efficient flight mode.

force_eco_regime.description: The calculation will be performed using the most efficient performance mode. Custom speed and altitude parameters will be ignored.

flight_time_offset.description: Flight time adjustment in minutes applied to the calculated flight duration; may be positive or negative.

great_circle_carbon_emissions.description: Carbon dioxide emissions via great circle using aircraft performance model in kilograms.

airway_carbon_emissions.description: Carbon dioxide emissions via airways using aircraft performance model in kilograms.

airway_carbon_emissions_weather_impacted.description:
Carbon dioxide emissions via airways using aircraft performance model with
historical average wind in kilograms.

errors.description: Sequence of error codes and messages caught during calculation.

warnings.description: Sequence of warning codes and messages caught during calculation.

techstops.description:
List of ICAO codes of recommended airports for techstop. Is displayed when "advise_techstop" is
         set to true and non-stop flight is not possible.

great_circle.description: distance via great_circle (shortest distance) in kilometers.

airway.description: Total amount of used fuel consumption via airways using aircraft performance model in kilograms.

airway_weather_impacted_detailed.description:

airway_weather_impacted_block.description:

great_circle_block.description: Total fuel required for the flight via great_circle including all reserved and extra fuel
